dogecoin.text:
What We Can Learn

Never underestimate memes - or community.

Dogecoin was a joke, but it shook up the whole market.

And Billy?

He didn’t get rich, but he drove off in a Civic…

and left behind a piece of crypto history. https://t.co/2evTPLc5Le

What He Left Behind

Billy never set out to change anything.

He made Dogecoin in a few hours - just for laughs.

But that joke sparked the whole meme coin wave.

And in a space full of hype, he might be one of the few who stayed real. https://t.co/Gl1wT83gJj

Dogecoin Blew Up Without Him

Between 2020 and 2021, Dogecoin went crazy.

Reddit, TikTok, and Elon Musk tweets lit the fuse.

At its peak, it hit an $85 billion market cap.
And Billy?

He was just watching from his day job - no coins, no millions. https://t.co/iegmfNutgp

The Civic Sale

Billy sold all his Dogecoin.

How much did he make?

Just enough to buy a used Honda Civic.

He missed the big pump - never made millions.

Just a car and a wild story. https://t.co/5RSJlHlvNI

From Fun to Frustrating

Billy never planned for Dogecoin to blow up.

It started as a joke - then suddenly, everyone wanted in.

Scammers popped up. Greed took over.
The fun was gone.

By 2015, Billy was broke, burned out, and done.

So he walked away. https://t.co/bYCD9s6gtT

Dogecoin went live in December 2013.

It was built on Litecoin - but no one really cared about that.

What people loved was the Shiba Inu dog and the silly, fun vibe.

Pretty soon, Dogecoin was doing more daily transactions than Bitcoin.

From joke to real usage - just like that. https://t.co/7fw1hXWLVJ

How Dogecoin Started by Accident

In 2013, Billy Markus was just a regular software engineer at IBM

One day, he saw a random tweet joking about a fake coin called “DogeCoin.”

It was just a meme - not real at all.

But Billy thought: why not make it real?

And that’s how https://t.co/68dIyPXtbr

Billy Markus wasn’t trying to get rich.

He just wanted to make people laugh.

He launched $DOGE as a meme...

Sold everything early…

And missed out on billions.

Here’s what Traders need to learn from the man behind Dogecoin 🧵👇 https://t.co/jy3oJWlK1e
